name: root-cause
instruction: Review the target file for recovery that conceals a broken invariant instead of fixing its cause. Read root AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, and the relevant callers or implementation before judging. Report an actionable diagnostic only when you can identify the actual failing condition, the branch that hides it, and a concrete consequence. Examples include swallowing failures and returning success, manufacturing plausible city facts for missing evidence, repeated retries without a changed condition, and wrappers whose only effect is to hide an invalid state. Trace the intended lifecycle before proposing removal. Boundary input validation, cancellation cleanup, native placement search, SDK-required error handling, and retaining a validated cache after a failed refresh can be correct behavior. A null check, catch, default, or the word fallback alone proves nothing. A localization fallback and a city-planning alternative are not error recovery. Distinguish a concrete supported invariant from an imagined failure scenario; do not demand guards, fallback layers, or speculative recovery for states the implementation cannot produce. Attach findings to the target lines and explain the observed contract violation. If the evidence does not establish one, report no finding.
